---
title: "Week 2 – R and Quarto"
case: housing
bibliography: [../../references.bib, ../../references-new.bib]
---
The second week is a first working session in R, on the data of the first case of the term: one public file of 1,014 emails sent to housing authorities in the United States, each signed with a name chosen to indicate a white, a Black or a Hispanic sender. The R module runs every one of its first thirteen sections on that file, so you can compare each result on the page with your own. The Quarto module explains the document format in which every case report of the term is written. The class meeting works through sections 8 to 10 of the R module together and renders a first document, and the paper of the original authors (OAs) and the first sections of the case study are read before week 3.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-reading), sections 6 to 13 | Reading the housing-audit data and looking at them; the pipe and the dplyr verbs; a share and a difference in shares, the quantity on which the claim of the case rests; a first table and a first figure; and a first call to `try_spec()`, the helper with which Task 4 explores the menu. | 120 minutes |
| [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd), sections 1 to 6 | The `.qmd` file and the render step, the YAML header, code chunks and their options, inline code, captions and cross-references, Markdown, and citations drawn from a `.bib` file. Then render the report of the workspace, `index.qmd`, once, to see the five tasks that you will fill in. | 75 minutes |
| The paper of the OAs [@EinsteinGlick2017DoesRaceAffect] | Read the whole article: the argument about the discretion of street-level officials, the design of the experiment, the email word for word, the four outcomes that were coded, the third model of Table 1, and the sentence of the abstract from which the claim was taken. | 60 minutes |
| [Case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd), sections 1 to 3 | [The original study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd#sec-study) and its design, [SCORE and Multi100](../../cases/housing/index.qmd#sec-score) with the claim as it reached the analysts, and [the five reanalyses](../../cases/housing/index.qmd#sec-reanalysts) and the question that each of them answered. | 45 minutes |

**By the end of the session** you have a script of your own that reads `housing_audit.csv`, counts the replies with a greeting code and the greetings by name for each group of names, and draws one figure from them; a rendered Quarto document holding that figure, a cross-reference to it and a citation; and the claim of the case written in your own words.
